scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "cd backend && go run ./cmd/server" "bun run --cwd frontend dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && go build -o ../bin/server ./cmd/server && go build -o ../bin/migrate ./cmd/migrate && cd .. && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p frontend && tsc --noEmit -p contracts && tsc --noEmit -p core && cd backend && go build ./... && go vet ./...
scripts.test: cd backend && go test ./... && cd .. && bun run test:core
scripts.db:generate: echo "스키마는 database/migrations/*.sql 이 원본입니다 — make gen-migration NAME=… 로 새 파일을 만드세요"
scripts.sqlc: cd backend && go run github.com/sqlc-dev/sqlc/cmd/sqlc@v1.30.0 generate
